industries.label: Property managers
industries.title: One operating system for
industries.sub: From 10 units to 1,000, Guestway gives multi-property managers a single command center for guest comms, cleaning, access, and revenue. Stop stitching tools together. Start operating like one team.

bullets.title: Multi-property at a glance
bullets.body: One inbox, one calendar, one cleaning queue across every building you manage, filter by portfolio, owner, or city in a click.

bullets.title: Owner-grade reporting
bullets.body: Per-unit P&L, occupancy, and review scores ready for owner statements without spreadsheet duct-tape.

bullets.title: PMS-agnostic
bullets.body: Works with Mews, Avantio, Hostfully, Hostify, Lodgify, OwnerRez, Beds24, and more. Connect multiple PMS systems at once, built for mixed portfolios and for groups still on separate stacks after a merger or acquisition.

bullets.title: Built for scale
bullets.body: Role-based access, sub-accounts per portfolio, and audit logs that survive the next compliance review.

industries.label: Aparthotels
industries.title: Hotel-grade service,
industries.sub: Aparthotels live in the gap between hotels and short-term rentals. Guestway is built for that gap, the same OS handles 30-night corporate stays, weekend leisure bookings, and everything in between, without forcing you to pick a side.

bullets.title: Hybrid stays, one workflow
bullets.body: Long-stay corporate guests, weekenders, and direct bookings all flow through the same inbox, calendar, and cleaning queue.

bullets.title: Self-service that actually works
bullets.body: Branded guest app handles check-in, ID upload, access codes, and upsells, so reception isn't a bottleneck at 11pm.

bullets.title: Cleaning at scale
bullets.body: Mid-stay cleans, turnovers, and deep-cleans scheduled automatically from booking events. Linen counts and supplies tracked per unit.

bullets.title: Revenue without the rev-manager
bullets.body: Pricing signals from your PMS surface in one place, so weekend uplifts and corporate-rate negotiations don't need a spreadsheet.

industries.label: Hotels
industries.title: Lift service scores
industries.sub: Independent hotels and small chains use Guestway to give the front desk superpowers, AI-drafted replies in 30+ languages, every guest's full context one click away, and ops automations that catch problems before reception even hears about them.

bullets.title: Faster, multilingual replies
bullets.body: AI drafts answers in the guest's language and your brand voice, receptionists approve and send in seconds.

bullets.title: Reviews that lift, not haunt
bullets.body: Centralize TripAdvisor, Booking.com, Google, and Expedia reviews. AI-drafted responses, sentiment trends, unit-level performance.

bullets.title: Ops that prevent escalations
bullets.body: AI Operations Center spots noise complaints, slow responses, and broken kit before they hit the GM's inbox.

bullets.title: Plays nice with your PMS
bullets.body: Native integrations with Apaleo, Mews, Cloudbeds, and friends, Guestway adds the AI layer without forcing a re-platform.

industries.label: STR
industries.title: Run more units
industries.sub: Short-term rental hosts and management companies use Guestway to compress the operational load of every booking, AI replies before the guest finishes typing, cleaning auto-scheduled the moment a check-out happens, access codes issued without a single manual click.

bullets.title: AI that handles the 80%
bullets.body: Repetitive guest questions ("can we check in early?", "is there parking?") answered in seconds, in the guest's language.

bullets.title: Cleaning on autopilot
bullets.body: Turnovers triggered by check-out events, dispatched to your cleaning crew, with photo-confirmation and inventory checks built in.

bullets.title: Access without keys
bullets.body: Smart-lock codes generated per booking, valid only for the stay, revoked automatically. Akiles, Nuki, and friends supported natively.

bullets.title: One inbox for every channel
bullets.body: Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, WhatsApp, SMS, and email all in one thread per guest, never miss a message because it landed in the wrong app.
